strategy_name: Quantamentals: Combined Fundamental and Technical Factor Strategy
abstract: Quantamentals: Combined Fundamental and Technical Factor Strategy is a factor strategy from Cain, Christopher and Connors, Laurence, 2020. Universe: US equities, broad stock market universe (similar to Russell 1000 or S&P 1500); rebalances monthly.
